panels.title: Usage · last 5 h
panels.description: Cost (cost_usd) per Claude account over the last 5 hours. Bar = that cost as % of the account's peak: its highest rolling 5-hour cost over the last 30 days (10-minute steps). Green below 60 %, yellow from 60 %, red from 80 %. Fixed windows: ignores the dashboard time range and the variables. Accounts with no cost in 7 days are not listed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    concat(if(t.label = '', '(no account)', t.label), '  ·  $', toString(round(t.h5, 2))) AS name,
    round(100 * t.h5 / greatest(p.peak, t.h5, 0.000001)) AS pct
FROM
(
    SELECT account_uuid,
           argMax(account, ts) AS label,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 5 HOUR) AS h5,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS d7
    FROM cc.api_requests
    WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS t
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT account_uuid, max(w) AS peak
    FROM
    (
        SELECT account_uuid,
               sum(c) OVER (PARTITION BY account_uuid ORDER BY b RANGE BETWEEN 17999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS w
        FROM
        (
            SELECT account_uuid, toUInt32(toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)) AS b, sum(cost_usd) AS c
            FROM cc.api_requests
            WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
            GROUP BY account_uuid, b
        )
    )
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS p ON p.account_uuid = t.account_uuid
WHERE t.d7 > 0
ORDER BY t.h5 DESC, t.d7 DESC

panels.title: Tips · 7 d
panels.description: Number of tips (view cc.tips, last 7 days). Click the value to open the Tips section of the Efficiency dashboard. Ignores the dashboard time range and the variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS tips
FROM cc.tips

panels.description: The most frequent tip category (view cc.tips, last 7 days) with its count in brackets (ties: alphabetical order). Click the value to open the Tips section of the Efficiency dashboard. Ignores the dashboard time range and the variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(tips = 0, 'none', concat(multiIf(top = 'cache', 'Cache rebuilds', top = 'repeated-read', 'Repeated reads', top = 'big-results', 'Big tool results', top = 'short-opus', 'Short Opus answers', top = 'agent-outlier', 'Costly agent run', top = 'denials', 'Denied tool calls', top = 'slow-hook', 'Slow hooks', top = 'slow-ttft', 'Slow first token', top), ' (', toString(n), ')')) AS most_frequent
FROM
(
    SELECT sum(c) AS tips,
           argMin(category, (-toInt64(c), category)) AS top,
           max(c) AS n
    FROM (SELECT category, count() AS c FROM cc.tips GROUP BY category)
)

panels.title: Tips · fixed last 7 days, ignore the time range and variables
panels.description: Usage tips from the view cc.tips. Fixed 7-day window: the dashboard time range and the variables do not apply. The cost and cache sections below follow the time range and the variables.

panels.title: Tips · 7d
panels.description: Number of tips in cc.tips (tips over the last 7 days), then how many of them are about tokens (affected is not null) and how many about time (denials, slow hooks, slow first token). Fixed 7-day window: the dashboard time range and the variables do not apply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS tips, concat(toString(countIf(affected IS NOT NULL)), ' token · ', toString(countIf(affected IS NULL)), ' time') AS name
FROM cc.tips

panels.title: Affected · 7d
panels.description: tokens, measured / not a saving estimate. Sum of cc.tips.affected over the last 7 days (result sizes are bytes / 4, so about this many tokens). Fixed 7-day window: the dashboard time range and the variables do not apply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ifNull(sum(affected), 0) AS affected, 'tokens, measured · not a saving estimate' AS name
FROM cc.tips

panels.title: Affected tokens by category
panels.description: Sum of cc.tips.affected per category, biggest first; the number of tips follows the value (about this many tokens: result sizes are bytes / 4). Fixed 7-day window: the dashboard time range and the variables do not apply. Time tips have no affected value and are not shown.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.category AS name,
    t.v / t.s AS value,
    m.mx / t.s AS max,
    concat('suffix:', multiIf(t.s = 1000000, ' Mil', t.s = 1000, ' K', ''), ' · ', toString(t.n), if(t.n = 1, ' tip', ' tips')) AS unit
FROM (
    SELECT category, count() AS n, sum(affected) AS v,
        multiIf(v >= 999950, 1000000, v >= 999.95, 1000, 1) AS s
    FROM cc.tips
    WHERE affected IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY category
) AS t
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT max(v) AS mx
    FROM (SELECT sum(affected) AS v FROM cc.tips WHERE affected IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category)
) AS m
ORDER BY t.v DESC, t.category

panels.title: Token tips · click a title to open its evidence
panels.description: Tips from cc.tips that are about tokens (affected is not null), sorted by affected, biggest first. Fixed 7-day window: the dashboard time range and the variables do not apply. The title link opens one evidence panel full-screen on the related dashboard, with the project / session / actor preset and the current time range. affected is about this many tokens (read results and big results: result bytes / 4; cache: cache-creation tokens). cost_usd is the cost of the requests the tip is about; empty where it cannot be measured. How the tips are made: the text panel at the bottom.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT category, title, body, scope, metric, affected, cost_usd,
       concat(link, if(position(link, '?') > 0, '&', '?'),
              if(startsWith(link, '/d/cc-sessions'), 'var-project=%24__all&', '')) AS open
FROM cc.tips
WHERE affected IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY affected DESC, category, title

panels.title: Time and friction tips · click a title to open its evidence
panels.description: Not about tokens, so not ranked by affected. Tips from cc.tips with no affected value (denials, slow hooks, slow first token). Fixed 7-day window: the dashboard time range and the variables do not apply. The title link opens one evidence panel full-screen on the related dashboard, with the project / session / actor preset and the current time range. metric is the number behind the tip (count or mean ms).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT category, title, body, scope, metric,
       concat(link, if(position(link, '?') > 0, '&', '?'),
              if(startsWith(link, '/d/cc-sessions'), 'var-project=%24__all&', '')) AS open
FROM cc.tips
WHERE affected IS NULL
ORDER BY category, metric DESC, title

panels.title: Where cost goes · follows the time range and variables
panels.description: sum(cost_usd) by work phase of the turn. Filtered by the time range and all variables.

panels.title: cost_usd per day by phase
panels.description: cost_usd of every model request, split by the phase of that response. The phase comes from the tools called in the same response (tool_result events with the same request_id as the api_request): Edit = any Edit / Write / MultiEdit / NotebookEdit; Delegate = Task / Agent (subagent launch) / SendMessage / SubagentHandback / TaskStop (subagent control); Run = Bash (without edits or delegation); Explore = only Read / Grep / Glob / LS; Talk = no tool result (a plain answer; also a tool call whose result was never recorded); Other = any other tool mix (MCP, web, Skill, ...). A response with several kinds of tools takes the first matching phase in the order Edit, Delegate, Run, Explore, Other. Days are in server time (UTC).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time,
       sumIf(c, ph = 'Explore') AS Explore,
       sumIf(c, ph = 'Edit') AS Edit,
       sumIf(c, ph = 'Run') AS Run,
       sumIf(c, ph = 'Delegate') AS Delegate,
       sumIf(c, ph = 'Talk') AS Talk,
       sumIf(c, ph = 'Other') AS Other
FROM
(
SELECT toStartOfDay(a.ts) AS time, if(t.tool_phase = '', 'Talk', t.tool_phase) AS ph, a.cost_usd AS c
FROM cc.api_requests AS a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT request_id AS rid, multiIf(countIf(tool_name IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'MultiEdit', 'NotebookEdit')) > 0, 'Edit', countIf(tool_name IN ('Task', 'Agent', 'SendMessage', 'SubagentHandback', 'TaskStop')) > 0, 'Delegate', countIf(tool_name = 'Bash') > 0, 'Run', countIf(tool_name NOT IN ('Read', 'Grep', 'Glob', 'LS')) = 0, 'Explore', 'Other') AS tool_phase FROM cc.events WHERE event = 'tool_result' AND request_id != '' GROUP BY request_id) AS t ON t.rid = a.request_id
WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Phase summary
panels.description: Same phases as the chart on the left (see its description). share = the phase's part of the cost_usd in the range; per turn = cost_usd per model request of that phase. Filtered by the time range and all variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ph AS phase, 100 * cost / greatest(total, 0.000001) AS share, cost AS cost_usd, cost / turns AS per_turn
FROM
(
SELECT ph, cost, turns, sum(cost) OVER () AS total
FROM
(
  SELECT if(t.tool_phase = '', 'Talk', t.tool_phase) AS ph, sum(a.cost_usd) AS cost, count() AS turns
  FROM cc.api_requests AS a
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT request_id AS rid, multiIf(countIf(tool_name IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'MultiEdit', 'NotebookEdit')) > 0, 'Edit', countIf(tool_name IN ('Task', 'Agent', 'SendMessage', 'SubagentHandback', 'TaskStop')) > 0, 'Delegate', countIf(tool_name = 'Bash') > 0, 'Run', countIf(tool_name NOT IN ('Read', 'Grep', 'Glob', 'LS')) = 0, 'Explore', 'Other') AS tool_phase FROM cc.events WHERE event = 'tool_result' AND request_id != '' GROUP BY request_id) AS t ON t.rid = a.request_id
  WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  GROUP BY ph
)
)
ORDER BY cost DESC

panels.title: Cache · follows the time range and variables
panels.description: Pauses between requests and cache hit rate. Filtered by the time range and all variables.

panels.title: Pauses between requests
panels.description: Gap between consecutive model requests of a session (requests that pass the variables and the time range, all actors together), counted per request. Past the 5-minute prompt-cache TTL the next request writes the cache again instead of reading it: those pauses are red (green: within 5 minutes). Gaps are between consecutive requests of a session, subagents included (filter Actor = main for the main conversation only); the first request in the time range has no predecessor and is not counted. Filtered by the time range and all variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT multiIf(gap < 60, '<1m', gap < 300, '1–5m', gap < 900, '5–15m', gap < 3600, '15–60m', '>1h') AS bucket,
       count() AS requests,
       max(gap >= 300) AS over_ttl
FROM
(
  SELECT cur - prev AS gap
  FROM
  (
    SELECT toUnixTimestamp(ts) AS cur,
           lagInFrame(toUnixTimestamp(ts), 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS prev
    FROM cc.api_requests
    WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  )
  WHERE prev > 0
)
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY min(gap)

panels.title: Cache hit rate by project
panels.description: Per effective project: model requests, cache hit rate = cache read / (cache read + input + cache creation) tokens, cache creation tokens (what a low hit rate costs), cost_usd. Hit rate colours: 90 % and above green, 75 % and above yellow, below red. Target of the cache tip. Filtered by the time range and all variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT project, count() AS requests,
       100 * sum(cache_read_tokens) / greatest(sum(cache_read_tokens + input_tokens + cache_creation_tokens), 1) AS hit_rate,
       sum(cache_creation_tokens) AS cache_create, sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY project ORDER BY cache_create DESC LIMIT 100

options.content:
| Category | Fires when (last 7 days) | What to look at / do | Link opens |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| cache | per project: at least 20 requests and cache hit rate below 40 % | keep the prompt prefix (CLAUDE.md, tools) stable; fewer /clear and model switches | Efficiency: Cache hit rate by project |
| repeated-read | per project and file: read more than 10 times | keep key facts in CLAUDE.md or a note instead of rereading | Tools & files: Files re-read within one session |
| big-results | per project: at least 5 tool results over 200 KB | narrow the search or limit the read range | Tools & files: Largest tool results |
| short-opus | per project: at least 20 Opus requests under 500 output tokens, and they are at least half of all Opus requests | a smaller model may handle such turns; the cost shown is the upper bound of the saving | Prompts: Most expensive prompts |
| agent-outlier | per subagent type: at least 3 runs, the biggest run over 6 times the mean and over 50k tokens | check what that run did | Sessions: Session timeline (session and actor preset) |
| denials | per project and tool: at least 5 rejected permission decisions | if the rule is intended, ignore; otherwise review the permission rules | Tools & files: Rejected tool calls |
| slow-hook | per hook: at least 10 runs and mean over 500 ms | hooks run synchronously and delay every matching tool call | Health: Hook time |
| slow-ttft | per project and model: at least 10 requests and mean time to first token over 3 s | long contexts or a busy provider | Health: Time to first token by day |
